name: PubMed-only real human LPS readout evidence; no simulation

statement.latest: Only independently published, source-verified PubMed-indexed human biochemical observations may be read out for candidate Toledo biological interpretation. The abstract CAN-003 F and the CAN-006/007/165 observation-factorization requirement remain unchanged. Missing native-step calibration or donor-level assay map => HOLD.
